findings.evidence: Mathlib `Ideal/Cotangent.lean:313` gives cotangent finite-dimensionality under `[IsNoetherianRing R]`, while `RegularLocalRing/Defs.lean:51` defines `IsRegularLocalRing` as extending `IsNoetherianRing`; `ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight` itself has no local-Noetherian assumption.
findings.fix: State the two finite-dimensional instances with `[IsNoetherianRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)]`, and remove `[IsLocallyNoetherian X]` from `finrank_zariskiTangentSpace_eq_coheight`.
findings.issue: Lines 64, 71, and 87 require `[IsLocallyNoetherian X]`, although only the stalk at `x` must be Noetherian; at line 87 this is already supplied by `[IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)]`.

summary: The scheme-level finite-dimensionality and regular-point APIs impose an unnecessarily global Noetherian hypothesis for pointwise statements.
